title: Double Drip Strawberry Ice Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Strawberry Ice delivers a cool twist on a classic berry flavour. Sweet, sun-ripened Strawberry forms the base with its smooth, juicy profile, while a wave of Menthol on the exhale keeps the vape fresh and clean. The result is a simple yet satisfying blend that balances soft fruitiness with a brisk, icy finish. This nicotine salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. It pairs perfectly with pod kits , vape pens and starter devices , offering smooth vapour, reliable flavour delivery, and a more comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
